referenceName: Amrit image-led heritage dining and menu journey

source.name: Amrit Palace official restaurant website
source.rightsEvidence: The requester attested that internal full-page desktop/mobile capture and derived design-prompt retention are cleared, and later explicitly confirmed that these screenshots may be sent to the LaunchLoom pipeline model as visual references. No restaurant-owner grant or written license was uploaded. See the requester-attestation and provenance files.

capture.method: Rendered the official website directly in an isolated agent-browser Chromium session; full-page screenshots were captured from the live source page, not from a gallery or third-party screenshot.
capture.diagnostics: All 69 img elements reported loaded at both final capture viewports; no broken images, no horizontal document overflow. The screenshots contain the original site's branding, copy, and photographs under the requester's attested internal capture/model-reference scope only. None of those original image files is included separately in this dossier.

provenance.attribution: Official source page: Amrit Palace, https://amritpalace.com/. Full-page captures retained under the requester-attested internal scope recorded in rights/REQUESTER-ATTESTATION.md.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The direct source uses a compact overlay navigation over a dramatic dining-room image, with restrained central display typography and clear reservation/order controls. It then shifts into a warm paper-and-ochre editorial system: a short dining story, a vertical signature-menu board paired with large food photography, a catering chapter broken into three image-backed offerings, a drinks section with staggered image rhythm and text list, a gift-card chapter, a dark interior scene, review proof, and a utility-dense footer for locations, hours, contact, newsletter, and actions. It is image-led but still gives menu rows and practical actions a visible place. The source's brand, food items, exact prices, copy, locations, reviews, hours, staff, and claims are excluded from transfer. The desktop capture is 1536 by 10310; mobile is 390 by 9461, both full-page live-site captures with no horizontal overflow.

heroGeometry.mode: immersive full-width dining image with compact overlay navigation and centered editorial title
heroGeometry.alignment: centered headline on a broad darkened dining-room field, followed by a slightly inset story scene
heroGeometry.viewport: brand, concise restaurant proposition, and a reserve/order route are visible in the first desktop viewport

navigationGeometry.mode: small wordmark and fine utility links over the hero, with compact reservation and order controls
navigationGeometry.placement: edge-aligned overlay at the top of the hero; utility/contact details reappear in the footer
navigationGeometry.mobile: compressed logo and icon/actions above the same image-led opening; the menu and ordering paths remain reachable

typography.display: high-contrast editorial serif for hospitality chapters and menu display
typography.body: restrained clean sans for item notes, operating details, and controls
typography.scale: large but elegant section titles, small utility labels, compact menu list with distinct item/price hierarchy

palette.contrastIntent: light text over a controlled hero overlay and dark food images; menu text remains high-contrast on a warm light surface

imageTreatment.mode: cinematic dining-room hero, large food images, catering activity triptych, drinks portraits, and a dark interior chapter
imageTreatment.crop: wide cover hero and varied wide/portrait food and hospitality crops
imageTreatment.focalPoint: preserve food or hospitality activity as the focal subject; the source photos are visual evidence only, not client photography

servicePresentation.pattern: text-forward item list with concise description and aligned price, contrasted against large food images; catering is grouped into a small number of photographic service chapters
servicePresentation.interaction: menu and reserve/order actions are direct links; keep item information readable without a slider or hover
servicePresentation.adaptation: use real menu, catering, beverage, dietary, pricing, and order tokens only; remove any offering the client has not verified

ctaPlacement.primary: reservation or order choice appears in the opening and repeats at menu or closing decision points
ctaPlacement.early: offer the most relevant booking path beside the opening promise, without forcing users to choose between multiple locations unless the business has them

motion.primitive: subtle section reveals and optional review carousel; no movement is required to read menu or location details
motion.library: CSS and native browser behavior; any carousel must use explicit accessible controls
motion.reducedMotion: show static images and all reviews or menu information; no autoplay or scroll-jacking

mobileRecomposition.strategy: long single-column restaurant journey with compact menu actions and full-width photography
rules: keep a short promise and the primary reserve/order route near the top
allow menu rows to stack with price and description visibly associated
stack catering imagery without shrinking labels below comfortable reading size
turn drink and guest-review rails into swipe-safe or stacked content with visible controls
keep location, current hours, and contact information easy to scan in the footer

prohibitedPatterns: copying Amrit Palace, its wordmark, tagline, exact dish names, prices, photographs, locations, hours, staff, reviews, rating counts, history, or hospitality claims
inventing menu items, ingredients, allergens, dietary suitability, sourcing, prices, operating hours, catering capacity, or reservation availability
presenting stock or generated food photography as the client's own dishes or dining room
using a review carousel as the only place to find practical restaurant information
turning every menu item into a decorative rounded card or placing the entire menu in an image
showing multiple reservation providers or location selectors when the client has one verified booking path

requiredSignatureElements.description: broad hospitality image opening with concise promise and direct action
accessible text-led menu hierarchy with verified prices when provided
small editorial image sequence for an additional service such as catering, only when offered
practical location, hours, and contact close using verified facts

acceptanceChecks: desktop hero has a readable promise, appropriate image treatment, and working primary action
menu and catering copy is bound to verified business data and does not invent price or dietary claims
photos are client-provided or separately rights-cleared and are not represented as client premises or dishes
mobile menu rows, service images, contact information, and booking routes remain readable with no horizontal overflow
review claims and rating details are used only when their source and current value are verified

review.scope: Official page rendered and captured at desktop and portrait-mobile widths; source mechanics are translated into a prompt and Reference DNA. Requester attestation permits model visual-reference use, but no owner grant file was uploaded.
